key_points: JPMorgan upgraded INTC from a long-standing bearish stance dating to 2022, citing improved management execution and accelerating AI/data center demand
Multiple Wall Street firms noted a shift in narrative around Intel's foundry business and AI growth trajectory
Stock gained >10% after dipping below $90, but faces lingering headwinds from BIS chip restrictions and robotics bans
Fund flows show modest institutional buying (Prime Capital, Sumitomo Mitsui, Net Worth Advisory)
Positive short-term momentum but medium-term viability still tied to product execution and geopolitical/regulatory risks
